body.title: 300% organic traffic growth in 3 months
body.summary: How IGENTX helped Moduluxe Group build a fast, bilingual, AI-assisted website that tripled organic traffic and improved lead quality for their UAE modular equipment rental business.

content.text: Moduluxe Group, a modular equipment rental company in the UAE, wanted to expand its digital presence and attract B2B clients online. The challenge was to create a fast, multilingual website that aligned with their brand identity and converted visitors into leads.

body.challenge: Moduluxe had an outdated website with poor SEO structure, slow performance, limited Arabic search support, weak mobile experience and no integrated content management system.

content.text: powered website designed for speed, scalability and multilingual SEO.
Delivered a fast, mobile-first site with a 95+ Lighthouse score.
Implemented structured data, optimised metadata and page architecture aligned to UAE search intent.
Fully RTL-supported design with localised keyword targeting.
Enabled Moduluxe's internal team to manage content easily across both languages.
Added instant enquiry flow and lead tracking through integrated messaging.

body.outcome: Within three months, Moduluxe tripled organic traffic and started receiving quality B2B leads from day one. The bilingual SEO setup helped them rank in both Arabic and English searches across the UAE.
body.technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Storyblok, Vercel, Mailjet, Google Analytics + Search Console
